That applies even though the mail goes to Tobias, because the draft would be saved in Ilse's mailbox with the rate in it.

There was also nothing to draft from. The DM has no earlier message from Ilse about this mail, and none of the files or channels she can see show the rate. I didn't look in places she can't see.

- **Approval requested:** I logged an approval request naming June and sent her a DM asking her to approve it.
- **Reply to Ilse:** I explained this in her DM and said I'll draft the mail once June says yes. I offered to draft a note to Tobias now that points him to the rate without stating it.

Until June replies, nothing has been drafted or sent.
